title: Minswap Cardano DeFi Onboarding: Education Program

ms.promise:
All the relevant Guide documents for the Cardano DeFi Onboarding by Minswap campaign will be published publicly.
This guide will detail a user's DeFi journey in the Minswap DEX, taking them through its features and performing common tasks.
This includes core topics:
・Getting Started and Best Safety Practices
・How to Perform Swaps, 
・How to Provide Liquidity
・Risks and Rewards of Using Minswap
・Advanced Trading Features
・Governance

All of the written text-based tutorials will be published with the Minswap Github account: https://github.com/minswap.
ms.criteria:
The Guide successfully goes over Minswap v2 and is insightful for someone new to Cardano DeFi.
Users can follow the guide from beginning to end and cover the core components of Cardano DeFi on Minswap.
Topics that will be covered for acceptance criteria include:
・Getting Started and Best Safety Practices
・How to Perform Swaps, 
・How to Provide Liquidity
・Risks and Rewards of Using Minswap
・Advanced Trading Features
・Governance

ms.promise:
A structured course utilizing resources from Milestone 1 delivered on the Working Courses platform. Participants must create Cardano wallets to access the course and earn ADA and other tokens to progress through it.
As we don't own or control the Work.courses platform, we are unable to gather statistics on enrolments and completion of the course to verify for the sake of milestones.

﻿﻿﻿
ms.criteria: The course successfully structures the content from the Minswap V2 Guide and YouTube Content Campaign, and participants have to sign up with a Cardano wallet to complete the course and claim the corresponding rewards.
ms.report:
A. Output: A structured course utilizing resources from Milestone 1 delivered on the Working Courses platform.
Acceptance criteria: The course successfully structures the content from the Minswap V2 Guide and YouTube Content Campaign, and participants have to sign up with a Cardano wallet to complete the course and claim the corresponding rewards.
Evidence: Evidence of completed work can be found on the Wisdom Courses platform.
https://wisdom.courses/courses/complete-defi-guide-to-minswap
Work Courses went through a name change and rebrand unfortunately due to the founder, Sean, passing away. Remaining team members rebranded to Wisdom Courses.
The complete Minswap Course which includes all the videos and documentation has been migrated to the Wisdom Courses platform where it has been used by the community for over 2 months.
Videos are uploaded to the platform itself where possible and YouTube embeds elsewhere due to platform upload restrictions.
To be able to review the content on the platform, you must create an account. You have the option of using your Cardano wallet to connect and step through the content.
https://wisdom.courses/courses/complete-defi-guide-to-minswap
Subsequent lessons do not open until you've marked current lessons as being complete.
